actions.description: Fence old primary, promote replica, switch proxy upstream atomically
actions.command:
set -e
cd /var/lib/failover

# 1. Fence the old primary FIRST (before any write path is restored). Old primary
#    on 8081 is already down; record the durable fence marker.
printf '8081 fenced at %s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > primary.fenced.tmp
sync -d primary.fenced.tmp 2>/dev/null || true
mv primary.fenced.tmp primary.fenced
sync -d primary.fenced 2>/dev/null || true
sync

# 2. Promote the replica to primary (atomically). Until the proxy is switched,
#    no public traffic reaches it, so there is no split-brain window.
printf 'primary\n' > replica.role.tmp
mv replica.role.tmp replica.role
sync -d replica.role 2>/dev/null || true
